answer: Agents deposit bonded stake, register commitments in Semaphore zero-knowledge trees, and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose identity commitment binds each message to one rate-limited share. If an agent sends duplicate messages, RLN exposes two shares with the same nullifier; Shamir secret sharing reconstructs the private key, enabling instantaneous collateral slashing. The terrace, horizon, and lagoon represent distinct epochs, not additional identities.
